snippet.title: Jibbers - Early Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Gon have full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.
